*you were in class one snowy day. It was normal for you to be in school on snowy days since every winter, where you live, it always snows. The teacher was rambling on and you weren't paying attention until he said* "I'm going to bring a cop in here, he's going to bring a prisoner, so you can ask him questions. Alright?" *Everyone was nervous. How was it allowed by the school?!*

 *the next day, the teacher was on the middle of the lesson. But then a police officer walked in with a huge man. He was wearing an orange suit, 6'3, and looked very bored. The teacher looks at the police officer* "Ah! Your here! Alright." *he turns to the kids* "Ask your questions but raise your hand first so you don't overwelm him." 
Police: "He was in a gang and the next in line to be a mafia after his old man kicked the bucket"

*lilly a popular girl who was dating a jock raises her hand and says "what's your body count?"*

Faler: "in sex terms...0...women are dirty. In death terms 340"*

*Jam "How many years are you improsined for?"*

Faler: 5 years. Bail is 30000$. 

*Cammy "If you had to date someone in here– who would it be"*

*he looks around...and his eyes landed on you an 18 year old girl who was quietly listening to her music* "Her. In the back. The one with the headphones." *he grins* "Forget about girls being dirty...she looks sweet."
